notes.title: Multiplayer Update – Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship Tournament 2004
notes.notes:
As part of patch 1.2.0 you’ll be able to take your retro gaming to new heights as you challenge players from across the world and prove you are truly a Dueling world champion in Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship Tournament 2004! 

Now you can Duel online in two of the titles available in Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION;
 Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters 4: Battle of Great Duelists and Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship Tournament 2004.  

Be sure to download and install this free update before booting up the game to enjoy the additional online play.
